newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Euroyen, Eurodollars sidle to steady close.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Euroyen, Eurodollars sidle to steady close.

text.p: SIMEX Euroyen and Eurodollar futures shuffled to a listless finish on Friday as a dearth of fresh leads and growing caution ahead of the Federal Reserve's policy meeting next week dampened activity.
Euroyen futures received some support from a sell-off in Nikkei markets ahead of a long weekend in Japan, but the lead March contract failed to break out of a three-tick band.
It ended at 99.17 against its CME close at 99.16 on volume of a mere 4142 lots. Japanese government bond futures for December settled at 122.10 unchanged from their opening.
Dealers said sentiment was positive across the Japanese yield curve on the belief the Bank of Japan would not raise interest rates before the end of the year.
But they said March Euroyen was expected to stay confined to a 99.12-99.20 range for the time being.
Eurodollar futures closed little changed after testing the downside on rising expectations of a rate hike next week.
The overnight release of unexpectedly strong U.S. August housing starts and weekly jobless claims data fuelled fears of a tightening.
December Eurodollars ended at 94.04 against their IMM settlement at 94.06. They are seen well supported at 94.00.
